issues.title: Ingest Newton County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $6,281,735 across 19 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,400,000), County Road Fund ($1,518,030), County Jail & Sheriff ($1,022,590). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Collector's Automation
issues.detail: Printed total is $77,100.00; the categories written on the form add to $67,100.00. The summary ordinance (p. 48) also lists $77,100.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile Circuit Court Juvenile Div/Probate
issues.detail: The form shows $18,980.00 with $21,980.00 written above it; the summary ordinance (p. 48) lists $21,980.00, so we use that. The categories written on the form add to $18,980.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
